entities.description: Default static world geometry. Builds a StaticBody3D with a single MeshInstance3D and a single convex CollisionShape3D shape.

properties.name: _vertex_merge_distance
properties.description: Adjustable value to snap vertices to on map build. This can reduce instances of seams between polygons.

properties.name: _cull_interior_faces
